metadata.description: Build playable LittleJS games with Claude: engine conventions, new-game scaffolding, API reference, and shape art.

plugins.name: littlejs
plugins.description: Make HTML5 games with the LittleJS engine. Scaffolds a complete playable project with the engine bundled - no clone, no npm install, no server - and applies the engine's conventions and hard-won pitfalls to any LittleJS code you write.
